title: Australia Westpac Leading Index Edges Toward Trend as RBA Stays Hawkish
summary: Australia’s forward growth momentum improved in August but remained slightly below trend. The six-month annualized growth rate in the Westpac–Melbourne Institute Leading Index rose from -0.17% in July to -0.09%, pointing to the likely pace of activity relative to trend over the next three to nine months. title: Japan’s ¥1.1tn Trade Deficit Exposes the Price Behind the Import Surge

title: Euro sticks to losses near one-month low as USD bulls retain control ahead of Fed decision
summary: The EUR/USD pair sticks to a negative bias for the fifth straight day and trades around the 1.1535-1.1530 area during the Asian session on Wednesday.
